purpose: Publication-only removal of execution identity and machine-local locators; no implementation, technical source facts, validation results, hardware conclusions or historical evidence hashes changed.

inherited_publication_mapping.scope: Stage50 mapping is retained byte-for-byte as a historical publication transformation; the records below describe the Stage51 source archive.

external_evidence_path_semantics.external-evidence/l083-lse/review/: Stable labels for external manifests, comparison receipts, build/data-test receipts, logs and ELF artifacts. These artifacts are not bundled in this source archive.
external_evidence_path_semantics.external-evidence/l083-lse/generated/: Generated chip JSON evidence, including ELF memory metadata. These are external generated artifacts, not bundled handwritten source files.
external_evidence_path_semantics.external-evidence/l083-lse/source-extrac: External vendor TXT extractions. Their unchanged SHA-256 and byte counts identify the TXT artifacts, not the PDFs from which they were extracted.
external_evidence_path_semantics.external-evidence/l083-lse/source-qualif: External source-qualification record, not bundled in this source archive.
external_evidence_path_semantics.repository_relative_paths: Handwritten source references use real repository-relative paths. Hashes in frozen source-authority and old-cohort records remain the reviewed historical identities and are not rewritten to later source bytes.

evidence_role_preservation: Independent review actions remain distinguished from producer-run build and data-test evidence. No producer result is relabeled as an independent execution, and no new hardware or board qualification is asserted.
scope_limit: This narrow overlay changes the listed engineering metadata only. It is not a repository-wide privacy cleanup or a new source, build, license, or silicon review.
